annotations.title: Search and monitor jobs across many companies (paid Apify Actor)

description:
WHAT: Run the Fairquery Apify Actor fairquery/company-jobs-feed over many companies or boards: board discovery, search filters, per-board history (first_seen/last_seen, new/updated/closed, repost detection), optional per-job re-checks and descriptions.
WHEN: Monitoring a company list ("what is new since yesterday?"), searching the verified starter list, or anything that needs history, closed/repost signals or more than a few boards.
WHEN NOT: One board right now (jobs_get_board, free) or one job (jobs_check_open, free).
BEHAVIOR: Read-only on job sites; requires APIFY_TOKEN and runs in YOUR Apify account (waits up to 300 s; history is kept in a named key-value store there). Same politeness rules as the free tools: documented ATS APIs only, 403/429 kill switch, robots.txt on careers pages.
COST: Paid, pay-per-event, billed to your Apify account: $0.00099 per job row, $0.0005 per board scanned, $0.00029 per re-check (confirmOpen), $0.0019 per company found by discovery; no start fee. Error, closed and merged rows are free. Example: 3 boards, 300 jobs = about $0.30.
RETURNS: Paged dataset rows: "job" rows (as jobs_get_board plus first_seen_at, last_seen_at, change, reposted, repost_of, stale_signal, duplicate_of), one "board" row per board (jobs_total, new, updated, closed), "company" rows for discovery, "error" rows (code, message, retryable).
PARAMETERS: companies, boards and useSeedList: at least one is required although the schema marks all optional (none -> INPUT_EMPTY, not billed). onlyNew implies history and compares with the last run that used the same stateStoreName, so use one name per saved search; the first run returns everything as new. limit/offset page the returned rows locally; every call starts a new billed run, so fetch the pages you need from one result instead of re-calling.
EXAMPLE: {"companies":["stripe.com","ramp.com"],"titleIncludes":["engineer"],"countries":["US"],"onlyNew":true}.

ats.description: Required. The applicant-tracking system hosting the board: "greenhouse" | "lever" | "ashby". Example: "ashby"

slug.description: Required. Board slug as it appears in the public board URL (case-insensitive): boards.greenhouse.io/{slug}, jobs.lever.co/{slug}, jobs.ashbyhq.com/{slug}; 1-100 chars: a letter or digit, then letters, digits, ".", "_" or "-". Example: "ramp" or "palantir"

companies.description: Optional (see PARAMETERS). 0-200 names, domains or board URLs. Example: ["stripe.com","Ramp","https://jobs.lever.co/palantir"]

confirmOpen.description: Optional boolean, default false: re-check each emitted job on its detail endpoint ($0.00029 each, max 200 per run)

departments.description: Optional, 0-50 strings, any-of. Department/team substring match. Example: ["engineering"]

excludeStale.description: Optional boolean, default false. true drops job rows with long_open = true (age_days > 60, counted from posted_at, or from first_seen_at when the ATS gives no date) or reposted = true (a new job id matching a job that closed on the same board within 90 days, from the history in stateStoreName, so never on a board's first tracked run). Free closed rows are not filtered by it

includeDescription.description: Optional boolean, default false: add plain-text descriptions (PII-scrubbed)

locations.description: Optional, 0-50 strings, any-of. Location substring match. Example: ["london"]

maxJobs.description: Optional integer 1-50000, default 5000: spend cap on billed job rows

offset.description: Optional items to skip, integer >= 0, default 0; pass nextOffset from the previous response

onlyNew.description: Optional boolean, default false: only new/changed jobs since the last tracked run (plus free closed rows)

postedWithinDays.description: Optional integer 1-3650, default off: keep only job rows whose ATS publish date (posted_at) is at most this many whole days old; rows without an ATS publish date (posted_at = null) are dropped. Free closed rows are not filtered by it. Example: 7

remote.description: Optional, "any" | "only" | "exclude", default "any" (no remote filter). "only" keeps job rows with remote = true (an ATS remote flag, or remote wording such as "Remote" or "Anywhere" in the location or title; see remote_basis); "exclude" drops those rows and keeps rows where remote is false or unknown (null)

stateStoreName.description: Optional, default "fairquery-jobs-feed-state": named key-value store for history in your Apify account

titleExcludes.description: Optional, 0-50 strings, any-of. Whole-word title exclusion. Example: ["intern"]

titleIncludes.description: Optional, 0-50 strings, any-of. Whole-word title match. Example: ["engineer"]

useSeedList.description: Optional boolean, default false: also scan all verified starter boards (each billed as a board)

name: jobs_search_companies

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

items.description: Result rows. Each has "type": "job" (job_key, title, company, locations, countries, remote, posted_at, verified_open_at, age_days, long_open, apply_url, source_url, ...), "board", "company", "seed_board", "open_check" or "error" (code, message, retryable)

meta.description: Tool-specific context: board totals, request counts, cost notes

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null when done

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

total.description: Total items after filters, before paging
